# `skillset move`

> Generated from Skillset's CLI presentation contract. See the [documentation system](../../development/documentation-system.md).

Preview and atomically move a skill between workspace and plugin collections.

## Usage

```text
skillset move <from> <to> [--yes] [--json] [--root <path>]
```

## Options

| Option | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `--json` | Emit exactly one versioned finite JSON result document. |
| `--root <value>` | Select the repository root; defaults to cwd or Git root according to the route. |
| `--yes` | Confirm a fully specified plan-first mutation without prompting. |

## Examples

```text
skillset move .skillset/skills/demo .skillset/plugins/tools/skills/demo
skillset move .skillset/plugins/tools/skills/demo .skillset/skills/demo --yes
```
